name: Senso Electronics
summary: An electronics shop built like a big deals hub: a blue header with a category mega menu, a photo hero beside the Deal of the Day, two even rows of round categories, deal rails with an Add to cart that turns into − n +, doorbusters, a best-seller bento, category pages with a filter panel, a three-column product page with specs and Frequently bought together, and a receipt-first cart.
